title: Line sketch: Floating Spheres and Portal
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: Against a solid backdrop, glossy spheres hang from thin lines beside a small mechanical gear, while a large fluid form with a glowing circular opening dominates the right. The composition mixes organic dripping shapes with mechanical details in a balanced, asymmetrical layout. Smooth gradients, reflections, and soft particles create a polished digital aesthetic (derived from painting #85).
